latest_release.name: v3.3.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: Got Minimal Firefox support up and running by @RandomGamingDev in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1952
* fix: swapped arguments for contains() call in predicates tutorial by @Galm007 in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1953
* build: support Node 20 installs by @wodeni in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1959
* fix(bloom): import Text shape type in DiagramBuilder by @jiwonMe in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1962
* feat(bloom): add subtype selector matching by @jiwonMe in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1964
* fix(editor): eliminated memory leaks caused by detached SVG elements, mouse event listeners, and render state pileup during resample/compile by @Galm007 in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1961
* fix(bloom): register encouraged terms as objectives by @jiwonMe in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1970
* fix(core): fix memory leaks from repeatedly creating a new MathJax pipeline per compile by @Galm007 in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1976
* fix(bloom): unique SVG namespaces across diagrams by @jiwonMe in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1963
* fix(editor): suppress InvalidDiagramIDError errors in the editor when repeatedly recompiling a diagram by @Galm007 in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1972
* ci: run Bloom tests and lint by @wodeni in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1981
* chore: bump version to 3.3.1 by @wodeni in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1984

## New Contributors
* @RandomGamingDev made their first contribution in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1952
* @Galm007 made their first contribution in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1953
* @jiwonMe made their first contribution in https://github.com/penrose/penrose/pull/1962

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/penrose/penrose/compare/v3.3.0...v3.3.1
